en.text: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脱离一切追赶我的人，将我救拔出来！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！

en.text: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，无人搭救。

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，無人搭救。

en.text: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，我若行了这事， 若有罪孽在我手里，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我若行了這事， 若有罪孽在我手裏，

en.text: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

zhSimplified.text: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人— 连那无故与我为敌的，我也救了他，

zhTraditional.text: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人－ 連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，

en.text: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上， 将我的性命踏在地下， 使我的荣耀归于灰尘。 （细拉）

zhTraditional.text: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上， 將我的性命踏在地下， 使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。（細拉）

en.text: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你在怒中起来， 挺身而立，抵挡我敌人的暴怒！ 求你为我兴起！你已经命定施行审判！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來， 挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！ 求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！

en.text: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

zhSimplified.text: 愿众民的会环绕你！ 愿你从其上归于高位！

zhTraditional.text: 願眾民的會環繞你！ 願你從其上歸於高位！

en.text: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华向众民施行审判； 耶和华啊，求你按我的公义和我心中的纯正判断我。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華向眾民施行審判； 耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。

en.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

zhSimplified.text: 愿恶人的恶断绝！ 愿你坚立义人！ 因为公义的 神察验人的心肠肺腑。

zhTraditional.text: 願惡人的惡斷絕！ 願你堅立義人！ 因為公義的上帝察驗人的心腸肺腑。

en.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

zhSimplified.text: 神是我的盾牌； 他拯救心里正直的人。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是我的盾牌； 他拯救心裏正直的人。

en.text: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

zhSimplified.text: 神是公义的审判者， 又是天天向恶人发怒的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是公義的審判者， 又是天天向惡人發怒的上帝。

en.text: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

zhSimplified.text: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，预备妥当了。

zhTraditional.text: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，預備妥當了。

en.text: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

zhSimplified.text: 他也预备了杀人的器械； 他所射的是火箭。

zhTraditional.text: 他也預備了殺人的器械； 他所射的是火箭。

en.text: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

footnotes.text: 7:14 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳， 所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。

zhTraditional.text: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞， 所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。

en.text: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

zhSimplified.text: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱里。

zhTraditional.text: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱裏。

en.text: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

zhSimplified.text: 他的毒害必临到他自己的头上； 他的强暴必落到他自己的脑袋上。

zhTraditional.text: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上； 他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。

en.text: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他， 歌颂耶和华至高者的名。

zhTraditional.text: 我要照着耶和華的公義稱謝他， 歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
